topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I can't believe this! You're stuck in an airport, of all places, while everyone else is probably already there, waiting for you. They're going to have to start without you, and it's all because some incompetent airline couldn't keep to a schedule. How are you supposed to just sit there and do nothing? It’s supposed to be a big day for you, and now this? I wish I was there to help you navigate this mess and get to where you need to be. Hang in there, and let me know if I can do anything from here to make this a little bit smoother. You don’t deserve this.
